$comment: VS Code / GitHub Copilot hook config (ADR-029). Event names from code.visualstudio.com/docs/agent-customization/hooks -- the same set Claude Code uses, deliberately. NOT VERIFIED on a real VS Code host; see the tracking issue. Default location is .github/hooks/*.json; ~/.copilot/hooks also works. TWO DIFFERENCES THAT MATTER: tool properties are camelCase (filePath, not file_path), which governance-hook.py already reads; and matchers are PARSED BUT NOT APPLIED, so the write hook fires on every tool call. The script filters on tool_name itself rather than trusting the matcher below.
